text: This report recommends that the name "Jack Christie Lane" be approved to identify a public lane south of St. Clair Avenue East, extending between Glen Eden Crescent and Glenfield Crescent. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Jack Christie Lane" for a public lane south of St. Clair Avenue East, extending between Glen Eden Crescent and Glenfield Crescent.
